The TELUS team acknowledges that our work spans many Territories and Treaty areas and we are grateful for the traditional Knowledge Keepers and Elders who are with us today, those who have gone before us and the youth that inspire us. We recognize the land and the benefits it provides all of us, as an act of reconciliation, as recommended by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission’s (TRC) 94 Calls to Action and express gratitude to those whose territory we reside on, work on or are visiting. Learn more about TELUS’ commitment to Reconciliation.

Manage cookies
©2026 TELUS

TELUS and our partners use cookies to enhance website navigation, analyze website usage, and provide relevant advertising and personalized content, including on third party websites. You have control over these cookies, and can choose to "Accept all cookies", adjust your preferences by clicking "Manage cookies", or if you're happy with the selection that we have made for you, simply click on "x". Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. To learn more about how we and third parties use your data, read our Cookie Statement and our Privacy Commitment.
